2115162671326839188.en_summary: I don’t disagree with anything you say except your implicit view that there is no autonomous competition. This is the same delusional thinking among $TSLA bulls from 2020-2021 when they insisted no one would be able to compete with TSLA in EV manufactured cost or scale, but wound up being sorely wrong in 2023-2025 as others (especially Chinese manufacturers) caught up to TSLA on manufactured cost. The same is true now: Waymo, BIDU, Pony.ai and others working with NVDA will be able to compete with TSLA in unsupervised autonomy, which will pressure TSLA’s current irrational 2026 P/E of 220x vs +45% long-term EPS growth.
2115162671326839188.zh_summary: 我並不不同意你說的任何事情，除了你隱含的觀點認為沒有自主競爭。這與2020-2021年$TSLA多頭的妄想思維相同，他們堅持沒有人能在電動車製造成本或規模上與TSLA競爭，但在2023-2025年被證明大錯特錯，因為其他人（尤其是中國製造商）在製造成本上趕上了TSLA。現在也是如此：Waymo、BIDU、Pony.ai以及與NVDA合作的其他公司將能夠在無監督自主領域與TSLA競爭，這將對TSLA目前不合理的2026年220倍市盈率相對於長期45%以上EPS增長施加壓力。
